pakistan.summary: António Guterres landed early Tuesday for an Oct 6–8 visit at Ishaq Dar's invitation, with meetings scheduled with the President, PM Shehbaz Sharif and the Army Chief, plus UNMOGIP and NDMA stops.
pakistan.title: UN chief Guterres arrives in Islamabad on three-day visit

pakistan.summary: Multiple major powerhouses shut down for technical reasons and won't return before Oct 16, triggering 3–4 hours of unannounced load shedding nationwide; LESCO alone faces a 1,000MW+ gap.
pakistan.title: Power shortfall crosses 4,500MW as plants go offline

pakistan.summary: The benchmark index fell 1.36% to close at 165,867 on Monday as domestic political noise and elevated oil prices drove broad-based selling.
pakistan.title: KSE-100 plunges 2,288 points amid political uncertainty

pakistan.summary: Speaking in Islamabad, the PM said the government is ready for dialogue if PTI ends its long march and sit-ins, warning that protest politics directly hits the economy.
pakistan.title: PM Shehbaz renews talks offer to PTI: 'End march, sit-ins and we will talk'

pakistan.summary: Petrol now Rs393.64/litre while high-speed diesel drops to Rs397.76/litre for Oct 6 — both fuels hovering near the Rs400 mark despite softer global crude.
pakistan.title: Petrol up 88 paisas, diesel down Rs1.88 under daily pricing

pakistan.summary: With QatarEnergy's force majeure extended to Nov 4 and Hormuz uncertainty lingering, Islamabad will pursue three October cargoes and engage Iran for safe vessel passage ahead of winter demand.
pakistan.title: Pakistan to seek three Qatar LNG cargoes for October

tech.summary: Bloomberg reports OpenAI is negotiating a $30 billion raise anchored by Abu Dhabi's MGX and other UAE funds (up to $10B via syndicate), with BlackRock also in discussions. IPO pushed to 2027 as the company cites AI safety focus.
tech.title: OpenAI in talks for $30B round with UAE funds, BlackRock at $1.4T valuation

tech.summary: Beam packs 501B total parameters with only 23B active per task, claiming reasoning comparable to China's GLM-5.2 at 3–4x less compute. Weights land later this month under Apache 2.0.
tech.title: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI unveils Beam, its first open-weight model

tech.summary: Ex-OpenAI/Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon told NYC lawmakers leading AI companies are 'extremely reckless', saying they can't prevent models from developing their own goals.
tech.title: AI whistleblower warns firms 'don't know how to stop models going rogue'

tech.summary: Arthur Mensch told a conference in Abu Dhabi that Mistral's newest model — unveiled today — outperforms Chinese models on cyber, rejecting the idea that Europe can't compete in AI.
tech.title: Mistral CEO says new model beats Chinese rivals on cybersecurity

tech.summary: LG Electronics signed a long-term agreement to supply 5 gigawatts of AI data-center cooling equipment in North America — a reminder the AI boom needs chillers as much as chips.
tech.title: LG lands 5GW AI data-center cooling deal, shares jump 6%
